description: This file defines the SSMEcuInit class, which implements the EcuInit interface. It processes a byte array representing ECU initialization data to extract an ECU ID in hexadecimal form and provides accessors for the ECU ID and the byte array.

classes.name: SSMEcuInit
classes.description: A class representing ECU initialization data, extracting ECU ID from a provided byte array.

methods.name: SSMEcuInit
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with ECU initialization bytes and extracts the ECU ID as a hex string.

methods.name: getEcuId
methods.description: Returns the extracted ECU ID as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: getEcuInitBytes
methods.description: Returns the original ECU initialization byte array.
